turns.content: Create a sample that shows a flat table with row grouping — regions as groups, cities as leaf rows, revenue and cost columns.

I'll build this against the DataViewModel <-> Renderer bridge directly: shape the sales dataset into FlattenedDataViewModelParams (group rows get null data, leaf rows get summed measures), encode depth/leaf/expanded bits with createRowMeta, and mount a Grid with the flat layout.
Sum revenue and cost across departments so each city is one row.
Done — the shaping helper aggregates by (region, city) and sums the measure fields across the department rows before building the column-major data arrays.
